## Body

For an installed-SDK check, inspect the runtime version actually running, not just the npm launcher package. In #250 the launcher package was 0.0.412-2 while the self-updated runtime was 1.0.114-0. Its package-local copilot-sdk/extension.js and types.d.ts were the relevant oracle.

Trace joinSession -> resumeSessionForExtension -> registerTools/registerHooks and the serialized registration. CLI 1.0.113+ reads tools.definitions and hooks.handlers; 1.0.112 reads flat tools/hooks. There is no compatibility fallback. #250 documents >=1.0.113. session.on listeners are separate from configured hooks: do not move or confuse idle/activity/final-reply subscriptions with hooks.handlers.

The corrected fake proves today's extension passes the expected nesting; it cannot detect tomorrow's upstream rename. No installed-SDK conformance sensor was added. Keep this explicit, alongside any missing live GREEN, rather than calling exact-head CI a real-runtime witness. The same-origin-oracle lesson is covered by the existing inventory note; this note supplies the Copilot-specific source and seam.

#250 at 84ca653e3c101153e06b890a8ee2ffb512eac5c7: pass-with-notes, verdict commit 83d4ea3; native CI 357/357. Live post-fix GREEN was still pending at review. Highest-value harness follow-up: a version-qualified real-SDK registration probe.
